/**
 * @name Command injection via subprocess
 * @description Using subprocess with shell=True and untrusted input can lead to command injection
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module CommandInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource or
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("getenv").getACall() and
      source = call
    )
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(SystemCommandExecution cmd |
      sink = cmd.getCommand()
    )
  }
}

module CommandInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<CommandInjectionConfig>;
import CommandInjectionFlow::PathGraph

from CommandInjectionFlow::PathNode source, CommandInjectionFlow::PathNode sink
where CommandInjectionFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Command injection from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Command injection through subprocess with user-controlled input from environment variables or remote sources

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Path traversal in file operations
 * @description Using user-controlled paths without validation can lead to path traversal
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/path-traversal
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module PathTraversalConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource or
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("getenv").getACall() and
      source = call
    ) or
    exists(DataFlow::ParameterNode param |
      param.getParameter().getName() in ["path", "dotenv_path", "filename", "file_path"] and
      source = param
    )
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(FileSystemAccess fa |
      sink = fa.getAPathArgument()
    )
  }
}

module PathTraversalFlow = TaintTracking::Global<PathTraversalConfig>;
import PathTraversalFlow::PathGraph

from PathTraversalFlow::PathNode source, PathTraversalFlow::PathNode sink
where PathTraversalFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Path traversal from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Path traversal vulnerabilities where user-controlled paths flow to file operations

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe file permissions
 * @description Creating files with overly permissive permissions can expose sensitive data
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-file-permissions
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-732
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["chmod", "open"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember(["NamedTemporaryFile", "TemporaryFile"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "File operation that may have unsafe permissions."
findings.hypothesis: Check for unsafe file permissions in file operations
